title: The Book of Zephaniah Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Zephaniah — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The word of the Lord which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.decoded: This is the message from the LORD given to Zephaniah, descendant of Cushi, Gedaliah, Amariah, and Hizkiah, during the reign of King Josiah of Judah.

verses.kjv: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: The LORD declares that He will completely destroy everything from the land.

verses.kjv: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: I will destroy humans and animals, birds in the sky, fish in the sea, and idols along with the wicked; I will remove people from the land, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;
verses.decoded: I will bring judgment on Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem; I will remove the remaining worshipers of Baal and the priests of the idol worshipers.

verses.kjv: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the Lord, and that swear by Malcham;
verses.decoded: I will punish those who worship the stars on their rooftops, those who swear by the LORD and also by the god Malcham.

verses.kjv: And them that are turned back from the Lord; and those that have not sought the Lord, nor inquired for him.
verses.decoded: I will punish those who have turned away from the LORD and those who have not sought or asked for Him.

verses.kjv: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord God: for the day of the Lord is at hand: for the Lord hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.
verses.decoded: Be silent before the LORD, because the day of the LORD is near; He has prepared a sacrifice and invited those who will be judged.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the day of the Lord’s sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king’s children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.
verses.decoded: On that day of the LORD’s sacrifice, I will punish the leaders, royal family members, and those who wear foreign clothes.

verses.kjv: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.
verses.decoded: I will also punish those who sneak into their masters’ houses, filling them with violence and lies.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.
verses.decoded: On that day, says the LORD, there will be loud cries from the Fish Gate, wailing from the Second Gate, and loud destruction from the hills.

verses.kjv: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
verses.decoded: Cry out, people of Maktesh, because all the merchants are destroyed and those who carry silver are gone.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The Lord will not do good, neither will he do evil.
verses.decoded: At that time, I will carefully examine Jerusalem and punish those who are complacent and indifferent, who think the LORD will neither bless nor punish.

verses.kjv: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.
verses.decoded: Because of this, their possessions will be taken, their homes destroyed; they will build houses but not live in them, plant vineyards but not enjoy the wine.

verses.kjv: The great day of the Lord is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the Lord: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
verses.decoded: The great day of the LORD is close, coming quickly; the sound of that day will cause even the strongest to cry out in pain.

verses.kjv: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
verses.decoded: That day will be one of anger, trouble, suffering, destruction, darkness, gloom, and thick clouds.

verses.kjv: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
verses.decoded: It will be a day of loud alarms and warnings against the fortified cities and their tall towers.

verses.kjv: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the Lord: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
verses.decoded: I will cause people to suffer so much that they will stumble blindly, because they have sinned against the LORD; their blood will be spilled like dust, and their bodies will be like refuse.

verses.kjv: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord’s wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.
verses.decoded: Their silver and gold will not save them on the day of the LORD’s anger; the whole land will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy, and He will quickly remove everyone living there.

verses.kjv: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;
verses.decoded: Assemble yourselves, yes, come together, you nation that is unwanted.

verses.kjv: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord’s anger come upon you.
verses.decoded: Before the command is carried out, before the day passes like chaff blown away, before the LORD’s fierce anger comes upon you.

verses.kjv: Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.
verses.decoded: Seek the LORD, all you humble people of the earth who obey His laws; seek justice and humility. Maybe then you will be protected on the day of the LORD’s anger.

verses.kjv: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
verses.decoded: Gaza will be abandoned, Ashkelon will become a wasteland; Ashdod will be driven out at midday, and Ekron will be completely destroyed.

verses.kjv: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the Lord is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.
verses.decoded: Woe to the people living along the coast, the Cherethite nation! The LORD’s message is against you: Canaan, land of the Philistines, I will destroy you completely so no one will live there.

verses.kjv: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
verses.decoded: The coastal area will become homes and huts for shepherds and places to keep their sheep.

verses.kjv: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.
verses.decoded: The coast will be for the survivors from Judah; they will graze their flocks there and rest in the houses of Ashkelon at night, because the LORD their God will come to them and end their captivity.

verses.kjv: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
verses.decoded: I have heard the insults from Moab and the insults from the people of Ammon, who have insulted my people and acted arrogantly against their land.

verses.kjv: Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.
verses.decoded: As surely as I live, says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Moab will become like Sodom and Ammon like Gomorrah—overgrown with thorns and salt pits, forever desolate. My people’s survivors will plunder them and my remnant will take possession.

verses.kjv: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: This is what they will get because of their pride, for insulting and boasting against the LORD’s people.

verses.kjv: The Lord will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.
verses.decoded: The LORD will be awesome and terrifying to them; He will weaken all the gods of the earth, and everyone everywhere—even on distant islands—will worship Him.

verses.kjv: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
verses.decoded: You Ethiopians will also be killed by my sword.

verses.kjv: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.
verses.decoded: He will reach out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria; He will make Nineveh a wasteland, dry like a desert.

verses.kjv: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.
verses.decoded: Flocks will rest in the middle of the city, along with wild animals from many nations. Birds like cormorants and bitterns will nest in the upper parts of the buildings; their calls will be heard at the windows. The doorways will be desolate because the cedar decorations have been stripped away.

verses.kjv: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
verses.decoded: This is the once joyful city that lived without fear and said in its heart, ‘I am the only one; there is no other like me.’ How she has become a wasteland, a place for animals to rest! Everyone who passes by will whistle and shake their fists at her.

verses.kjv: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
verses.decoded: Trouble is coming to the filthy and corrupt city that oppresses others!

verses.kjv: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the Lord; she drew not near to her God.
verses.decoded: She did not listen to guidance, refused to accept correction, did not trust the LORD, and did not seek God.

verses.kjv: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
verses.decoded: Her leaders are like roaring lions, and her judges are like wolves that come at night, quickly devouring their prey.

verses.kjv: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
verses.decoded: Her prophets are unreliable and deceitful; her priests have defiled the holy place and violated the law.

verses.kjv: The just Lord is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.
verses.decoded: The righteous LORD is among her and will not do wrong; every morning He reveals His justice without fail, but the wicked feel no shame.

verses.kjv: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.
verses.decoded: I have destroyed the nations; their towers lie in ruins, their streets are empty, and their cities are abandoned with no one living there.

verses.kjv: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.
verses.decoded: I thought you would fear me and accept correction so your homes wouldn’t be destroyed despite my punishment, but instead you acted quickly to do evil.

verses.kjv: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the Lord, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
verses.decoded: So wait for me, says the LORD, until the day I rise to claim my victory. I will gather the nations and kingdoms to pour out my anger and fierce wrath; the whole earth will be consumed by the fire of my jealousy.

verses.kjv: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent.
verses.decoded: At that time I will give the people a pure language so they can all call on the name of the LORD and serve Him together in unity.

verses.kjv: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
verses.decoded: From far away, even from beyond the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people will bring me their offerings.

verses.kjv: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.
verses.decoded: On that day you will no longer be ashamed for your past sins, because I will remove from among you those who boast in their pride, and you will no longer be arrogant about my holy mountain.

verses.kjv: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the Lord.
verses.decoded: I will leave a humble and needy group among you, and they will rely on the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.decoded: The remaining people of Israel will no longer do wrong or tell lies; no deceit will be found in their speech. They will live peacefully and safely without fear.

verses.kjv: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be happy and celebrate with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem!

verses.kjv: The Lord hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the Lord, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.
verses.decoded: The LORD has removed your punishments and driven out your enemies. The LORD, the King of Israel, is living among you, and you will no longer face harm.

verses.kjv: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
verses.decoded: On that day, people will say to Jerusalem, 'Don’t be afraid,' and to Zion, 'Don’t give up or lose hope.'

verses.kjv: The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
verses.decoded: The Lord your God is powerful and living among you; He will save you. He will be filled with joy because of you, He will be quiet in His love, and He will celebrate you with singing.

verses.kjv: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.
verses.decoded: I will bring together those from you who are grieving because of the special religious gatherings, those who have been burdened by shame.

verses.kjv: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.
verses.decoded: Look, at that time I will remove all your troubles. I will save those who stumble and bring back those who were scattered. I will give them honor and a good reputation everywhere they were once disgraced.

verses.kjv: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: At that time I will bring you back and gather you. I will make you famous and praised among all the people of the earth when I restore your freedom right before your eyes, says the Lord.
